_about: Instagram platform facts the tools check against. Each entry carries a confidence level. 'high' = stable and widely documented. 'medium' = documented but has changed recently or varies by account. 'verify' = widely reported, not confirmed against Instagram's own help pages when this file was written. Platforms change: if Instagram disagrees with this file, Instagram is right. Override any value in ~/.creator-content-kit/config/platform.json.

visible_chars.note: Approximate. The feed cut moves with device, font size and line breaks. Treat as a margin, not a target.

max_hashtags.note: Widely reported as cut from 30 to 5 in Dec 2025 via the @creators account; some guides still cite 30 from the Help Center. 5 is the safe setting either way.

highlight_title_visible_chars.note: Longer titles get truncated under the circle.

recommended_size.note: 4:5 portrait takes the most feed space. All slides share the first slide's aspect ratio.

grid_crop.note: The profile grid shows a 3:4 crop of the cover. Keep the cover headline inside the centre.

max_seconds_upload.note: Up to 20 minutes for some accounts; 3 minutes is the broadly available ceiling. Shorter reels are still the norm for reach.

safe_zone_note.value: Keep on-screen text out of the bottom ~20% and top ~14% where UI overlays sit.

api_standard_window_hours.note: Instagram Messaging API: a business can reply freely within 24 hours of the user's last message. Outside it, only specific approved message tags apply.

api_requires_user_first.note: Automated DMs through the official API and approved partners only start after the user messages, comments or replies to a story first.

automation_policy.value: Official Instagram Graph API / Messaging API or Meta-approved partners only. No password sharing, no browser automation, no scraping, no automated follow/like/comment.
